profiles.method: Modelled from published heights: straight lines from the measured ground where the deck leaves it at Milsons Point and rejoins it at The Rocks, to a crest of 52 m at mid-span. The real deck curves, so its grades near the ends are probably steeper (the railway climbs at 1 in 40).
profiles.name: Sydney Harbour Bridge
profiles.source: Engineers Australia heritage listing (the deck is suspended 52 m above the water); the deck's ends follow the measured approaches (Geoscience Australia 5 m DEM)
